tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
ALL OTHER TERMS AND CONDITIONS AS PER TENDER DOCUMENT

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Organization/ firms/ companies having minimum 3 years experience in providing Manpower Services in Karnataka are eligible to participate.

Performance Experience of providing Manpower services in preceding three financial years 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 in a single order to Government Department/ Government Undertaking/ Government Organization/ Private Institutions in India.

Local Presence As on the last day of bid submission the Bidder should have had a fully functional Registered office/Service/Support centre in Karnataka (preferably in Bengaluru) for a minimum period of 3 years with GST/ VAT/ Service Tax/ Sales Tax Registration.

OR Delisted/ barred/penalized by the Government e-Marketing Portal (GeM) for the reasons of not fulfilling or breach of terms of the Portal as on the date of Tender submission.
